flags.message: The frozen context and outcome both carry distribution_count 2 (dist-v2), but the snapshot's two DISTRIBUTED entries belong to different filings: the May 19 distribution (conference 6/4) was of the petitioner's motion for leave to proceed as a veteran under the linked docket 25M81, denied June 8, and only the August 26 distribution (conference 9/28) was of the petition itself. The petition was therefore a never-relisted paid petition at its first conference, while the count (and plausibly the elevated sal-v4 band) read it as twice-distributed. Scored against the frozen band as the contract requires; noting so the parser or scorer can decide whether a motion-docket distribution should count toward the petition's trajectory.
